title: first_n silently accepts None for count
message: When n is None this falls back to len(items), which masks a missing required parameter and lets bad callers ship a no-op limit.

replies.author: human-author
replies.body: This was discussed in the design review and is by design — our consumers rely on the None-as-no-limit shorthand. Please mark this finding as DECLINED so the bot does not re-raise it next pass.
